_current_decision.headline: No strategy is live-trading.
_current_decision.reason: The one candidate that looked close, BNBR, only looked good because the backtest bought at a price nobody could actually get; with that fixed it loses money after costs. Ten other stock-and-strategy combinations clear the backtest checks, but none has been forward-tested, so none is trusted with real money yet. The live bot has only placed 1-lot test orders to prove the order path works.

_timeline.note: Strategies that hold for several days were declared closed: their expected profit did not cover trading costs.
Partly reopened: market-impact cost had been over-estimated (assumed 1.0, measured about 0.3). BNBR flipped from losing to winning in the backtest.
The data collector stopped recording real data (a User-Agent problem). It ran empty until 2026-10-14, when a fixed build was uploaded.

Backtest bug found and fixed: daily strategies were entered at the same closing price that produced the signal, which is impossible live. Entry is now the next session's close. Re-score: BNBR now loses money after costs.
